judge.claim_quote: National-level findings for Peru are carried by the national record and are not restated here; region-level sources concern Amazonas, Brazil ... not applicable to Amazonas, Peru.
judge.evidence: The text is a scope/bookkeeping note about which record restates which sources (Brazilian Amazonas sources excluded; Peru national findings held at national level). It never asserts that a Peru national restriction fails to apply to Amazonas, Peru.

judge.evidence: The claim asserts school/health restrictions exist only in other parts of Canada, not BC. No record source (StatCan, Egale, Wikipedia LGBTQ pages) or parent excerpt mentions such school/health restrictions, and the parent excerpt does not state a national school/health rule, so neither settles applicability.
